properties.name: billing.defaults.purchase-order-required
properties.description: Default billing rule requiring purchase order numbers.

properties.name: invoice.tax.base-url
properties.description: Base URL for tax calculation requests from pos-invoice.

properties.name: pos.events.base-url
properties.description: Base URL of the pos-events/event-receiver API.

properties.name: pos.events.api-secret
properties.description: Shared secret used to authenticate event type registration requests.

properties.name: pos.invoice.party-backfill.enabled
properties.description: Enable the scheduled job that backfills invoices.customer_id for pre-#920 invoices from the ext_workorder replica (#921).

properties.name: pos.invoice.party-backfill.interval-ms
properties.description: Fixed delay in milliseconds between party-id backfill runs; the first run happens immediately at startup.

properties.name: pos.security.base-url
properties.description: Base URL for permission registration against pos-security-service.

properties.name: pos.security.permission-registration.enabled
properties.description: Enable startup permission registration with pos-security-service.
